About

About Eurovision Games

A free, fan-built browser party game for the Eurovision Song Contest. It started as a spreadsheet between friends and grew into a real-time multiplayer app for any group hosting a Eurovision night — with automatic scoring so the host doesn't have to miss the show.

What is Eurovision Games?

Eurovision Games is a free, browser-based party game played alongside the Eurovision Song Contest broadcast. Hosts spin up a private room in 60 seconds and share the code; guests join with just a display name. The game has three parts: predictions from party start until voting opens (build and refine your Top 5 and Worst 5), trivia and duels in the same window, before and during the show (3 quiz rounds plus head-to-head 12-second duel rounds in the ad breaks), and trophies after the winner is announced (Champion, Oracle, Guru, Duelist, Thief). Everything scores automatically.

Why we built it

Watching Eurovision is great. Watching Eurovision with stakes is better. The existing options — printed bingo cards, paid quiz packs, custom Google Sheets — all break in the same way: someone has to do the scoring, and that someone misses half the show. We wanted live, automatic scoring that didn't cost anything and didn't require an install. That's the entire product.

Five principles, no exceptions

  • Free, always. No subscriptions, no ads, no premium tier.
  • No download. If it can't open in a browser, it's not the Eurovision experience.
  • No accounts. Not even the host signs up; guests join with a name.
  • Mobile-first. Most people play from a sofa with a phone in hand.
  • Real fun, not gamified. Five winner categories, sudden death, real bragging rights — no streaks, no daily challenges.

What's in the game

  • Predictions — build your Top 5 and Worst 5; they lock automatically when voting opens. Points stack as the results come in. See this year's predictions page.
  • Quiz — 3 rounds of Eurovision trivia, played at your own pace from party start until voting opens.
  • Duels — 3-question head-to-head trivia battles, before and during the show until voting opens. Steal your duel score from the loser or double it. Full duel rules.
  • Trophies — five end-of-night categories (Champion, Oracle, Guru, Duelist, Thief). Sudden-death tiebreaks if two players tie.

Free, no account, no install

Eurovision Games is free for personal Eurovision watch parties. There is no subscription, no in-app purchase, and no advertising — anywhere on the site. Nobody signs up: the host creates a room in seconds, and guests join with just a display name and a room code. Nothing to download, nothing to install. The whole thing runs in your browser on phone, tablet, or laptop.

Not affiliated with the EBU

Independent fan project

Eurovision Games is an independent fan project. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the European Broadcasting Union, the Eurovision Song Contest, the host broadcaster, or any participating broadcaster. "Eurovision" is a trademark of the EBU; we use it descriptively only to indicate the broadcast this game is designed to accompany. Country names, song titles, artist names, and related marks remain the property of their respective owners.

Built by

Built by a small team of Eurovision fans who got tired of doing prediction maths by hand.
